full_text_zh:
[P1] 猫咪小皮
真调皮
撰文/胡妙芬 插画/朱家钰

[P3] 猫咪小皮真调皮！天色黑漆漆，你还跑出去，难道不怕看不见，摔进水沟里？
晚上很暗，我们人类的眼睛看不清楚。可是猫咪不一样，它们习惯在夜间活动，属于“夜行性动物”。
猫咪的眼睛不但能接收光线，还能够反射光线，帮助猫咪看得更清楚，所以在黑暗的地方，猫咪的眼睛看起来好像会发亮。
亲子游戏
数一数，街上藏着几只猫呢？
● 猫咪眼睛的变化
大太阳的时候 白天的时候 黑夜的时候

[P4] 猫咪尾巴真厉害
小皮乖，请你快下来！
屋顶和墙头不是游戏场，你
在墙上走，万一摔下来，屁股
摔疼了，怎么办？

猫咪的尾巴除了帮助平衡以外，还能
表达心情。① 表示想跟你玩，
② 表示生气，③ 表示
害怕。

我生气了！

啊——

我想跟你玩！

我好害怕！

亲子游戏 生气的猫在哪里？

[P5] 猫咪跳跃本领高
小皮请你别爬高，快快下来吧！啊——掉下来了，这下摔得不轻吧？哇！没想到你这么棒，轻轻一翻身，就能安全着地。
亲子游戏 猫咪跳下树，在第几个连续动作图中，把身体转正的呢？
猫咪的脚掌上，长着软软的肉垫，所以走起路来几乎没有声音，非常适合用来埋伏、打猎。
猫咪的身体柔软又灵活，从高的地方摔下来，身体也能快速转正，用四只脚安全着地，所以几乎不会受伤。
小皮，快回来！
5/11

[P6] 猫咪胡须妙用多
别以为躲进去，
我就抓不到你！
多知道一点
家里养的猫虽然大部分吃饲料，但
猫其实是肉食性动物，会抓老鼠、
昆虫、小鸟或蛙类来吃。
亲子游戏
说说看，左边小图中
的猫咪在做什么？
猫要钻进小洞或窄缝以前，会先用胡须的
长度画一个圆圈。比圆圈大的洞，就能钻
进去；比圆圈小的洞，就钻不进去。
● 钻得进去吗？
用胡须量量看。
洞太小了，
我钻不进去！
呼，终于安全了！

[P7] 猫咪小皮爱撒娇
小皮回来了，走路静悄悄的，
没有发出声音。它突然靠近我，吓
了我一跳，仔细一看，原来就是猫
咪小皮！

猫的爪子
平常爪子收起

抓猎物时伸出来

猫的爪子平常缩在脚掌里，
只有捕捉猎物的时候，才会
伸出来，所以不会被磨平，
可以一直保持尖利。

肚子饿了吧？
我来喂你。

喵——

猫咪喜欢把它身上的气味涂抹
在主人身上，表示主人是它
的，其他的猫不准靠近。它们
也会把气味涂在家具或其他地
方，表示这些也是它的。

亲子问答
猫咪为什么喜欢用头、脸和身体磨蹭主人呢？

[P8] 我知道
猫舌头上的小刺，
可以像梳子一样，
用来梳理猫毛，让
毛发和胡须保持干净；也可以像小刀
一样，把骨头上的
肉屑刮下来，将食
物吃得干干净净。

喵——
猫咪好棒，又乖又
爱干净，我最喜欢
小皮了。

爱干净又温柔的猫咪
今天晚上，猫咪小皮的探险之旅结束了。它回到家后吃
吃东西、舔舔毛，调皮捣蛋的小皮，又变回了我的乖乖猫。

猫咪的舌头上长满了
许多小小的倒刺。

[P9] 猫咪 我真喜欢你
猫咪猫咪，真顽皮，
爱爬高高，爱玩游戏。
猫咪眼睛，亮晶晶，
看到老鼠就追过去。
可爱的猫咪，
活泼的猫咪，
温柔的猫咪，
我真喜欢你！
给爸妈的悄悄话
这首儿歌在编曲上，选用了无音高的打击乐器——圆柱状的康加鼓，还有沙铃
来贯穿全曲，爸爸妈妈可以试着和小朋友一起在歌曲中找出这些声音，并且跟着节
奏一起敲敲打打。这首儿歌的歌词还描述了猫咪不同的个性，因此在和声的编写上，
特别加入了“喵”声，让小朋友可以一边唱歌，一边模仿猫咪的叫声，不论以哪种
形式的猫叫，或孩子自创的猫叫方式都可以，借此增加哼唱的趣味性。
full_text_en:
[P1] Kitten Xiao Pi
Really Mischievous
Written by Hu Miaofen, Illustrated by Zhu Jiayu

[P3] Kitty Xiao Pi is so naughty! It's pitch dark outside, and you're still running out. Aren't you afraid of not seeing and falling into a ditch?
It's very dark at night, and human eyes can't see clearly. But cats are different—they are used to being active at night and are called 'nocturnal animals'.
Cats' eyes can not only receive light but also reflect it, helping them see more clearly. So in dark places, cats' eyes seem to glow.
Parent-Child Game
Count how many cats are hiding on the street?
● Changes in Cats' Eyes
When it's sunny When it's daytime When it's nighttime

[P4] Cat Tails Are Amazing
Little Pi, please come down!
The roof and walls are not playgrounds. If you walk on the wall and fall, what will you do if your bottom hurts?

A cat's tail helps with balance and also expresses emotions. ① means 'I want to play with you', ② means 'angry', ③ means 'afraid'.

I'm angry!

Ah——

I want to play with you!

I'm so scared!

Parent-Child Game: Where is the angry cat?

[P5] Cats Are Great Jumpers
Xiao Pi, please don't climb too high, come down quickly! Ah— you fell! Did that hurt? Wow! I didn't expect you to be so great— just a quick flip, and you land safely.
Parent-Child Game: When the cat jumps down from the tree, in which of the consecutive action frames does it right itself?
Cats have soft pads on their paws, so they walk almost silently, which is perfect for hiding and hunting.
Cats' bodies are soft and flexible. When they fall from a height, they can quickly right themselves and land safely on all four paws, so they rarely get hurt.
Xiao Pi, come back quickly!
5/11

[P6] Cat Whiskers: Many Uses
Don't think hiding in there will save you!
Did You Know?
Most house cats eat pet food, but
they are actually carnivores who catch mice,
insects, birds, or frogs to eat.
Parent-Child Game
Can you tell what the cat in the small picture on the left is doing?
Before a cat tries to squeeze into a small hole or narrow crack, it first uses the length of its whiskers to draw a circle. If the hole is bigger than the circle, it can fit in; if the hole is smaller than the circle, it can't fit.
● Can it fit in?
Use the whiskers to measure.
The hole is too small,
I can't get in!
Phew, finally safe!

[P7] Kitten Xiao Pi Loves to Be Affectionate
Xiao Pi is back, walking quietly without making a sound. It suddenly came close to me, startling me. Upon closer look, it was just kitten Xiao Pi!

Cat's Claws
Claws normally retracted

Extended when catching prey

A cat's claws are normally retracted into its paws. They only extend when catching prey, so they won't be worn down and can stay sharp.

Are you hungry? I'll feed you.

Meow——

Cats like to rub their scent onto their owners, marking them as their own and warning other cats to stay away. They also mark furniture or other places with their scent to claim them as their territory.

Parent-Child Q&A
Why do cats like to rub their heads, faces, and bodies against their owners?

[P8] I Know
The tiny barbs on a cat's tongue
are like a comb,
used to groom fur, keeping
hair and whiskers clean; they can also be like a small knife,
scraping meat off bones, leaving food
completely clean.

Meow——
Cats are great, so well-behaved and
loving cleanliness. I love
Little Pi the most.

Clean and Gentle Cats
Tonight, Little Pi the cat's adventure has ended. After returning home, it eats,
licks its fur, and the mischievous Little Pi turns back into my well-behaved cat.

A cat's tongue is covered with
many tiny backward-facing barbs.

[P9] Cats, I Really Like You
Cats, cats, so naughty,
Love to climb high, love to play games.
Cats' eyes, bright and shiny,
See a mouse and chase it away.
Cute cats,
Lively cats,
Gentle cats,
I really like you!
Whispers for Parents
In the arrangement of this children's song, unpitched percussion instruments—cylindrical conga drums and shakers—are used throughout. Parents can try to help children find these sounds in the music and tap along with the rhythm. The lyrics of this children's song also describe different personalities of cats. Therefore, in the harmonic arrangement, a special "meow" sound has been added, allowing children to sing along while imitating the cat's meow. Whether it's any form of meow or a child's own creative meow, it can add fun to humming.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本封面，展示了一只名叫小皮的调皮猫咪在草地上翻滚，背景是温馨的小镇，下方有一只受惊的小老鼠，整体画面充满童趣。
[P3] 本页描绘了夜晚小镇的场景，调皮的猫咪小皮在草地上玩耍，小女孩担心它会摔进水沟。页面通过文字解释了猫咪是夜行性动物，眼睛在黑暗中能反射光线，因此看起来会发亮，并附有亲子游戏和猫咪眼睛变化的示意图。
[P4] 本页通过多个场景展示猫咪尾巴的不同姿态及其对应的情绪，如想玩、生气和害怕，并配有小女孩对猫咪的关心和亲子互动游戏，旨在帮助儿童理解猫咪行为。
[P5] 本页通过小女孩对猫咪小皮的关心和猫咪从高处跳下的场景，介绍了猫咪跳跃时能安全着地的本领，并解释了其脚掌肉垫和身体灵活的生理特点，同时包含一个亲子互动游戏。
[P6] 本页介绍了猫咪胡须的妙用，通过图文解释猫咪如何用胡须测量洞口大小以判断能否钻入，并包含亲子互动游戏和关于猫咪食性的科普知识。
[P7] 本页描绘了猫咪小皮回家后与小女孩互动的温馨场景，通过文字和插图介绍了猫咪爪子的结构与功能，以及猫咪通过摩擦身体标记气味的行为，并提出了亲子问答问题。
[P8] 本页描绘了猫咪小皮回家后与小女孩互动的温馨场景，通过文字和插图介绍了猫咪舌头上的倒刺及其功能，包括梳理毛发和刮食肉屑，并展示了猫咪进食和舔毛的日常行为。
[P9] 本页以儿歌形式描绘了猫咪顽皮、活泼、温柔的特性，并通过插图展示猫咪在奶酪、茶杯、意大利面等场景中的可爱形象，同时附有给家长的音乐互动建议。
[P10] 画面描绘了小女孩在户外观察多只猫咪的活动场景：一只虎斑猫在追逐老鼠，一只花猫在树上，另一只虎斑猫从高处跳下，还有一只花猫正攀爬树干，展现了猫咪活泼好动的天性。
